documents: The outdoor infinity pool is open from 8 AM to 10 PM.
Children under 12 must be supervised in any pool area.
Pool towels are available at the spa reception.
The indoor heated pool is open 24/7 for all guests.
The sauna is located next to the indoor pool and is not recommended for children under 16 due to the heat.
The children's pool is open from 10 AM to 6 PM, supervised by lifeguards.
The adults-only pool is open from 6 AM to 8 PM.
The poolside bar serves drinks and snacks from 11 AM to 6 PM.
The spa also offers a separate private sauna suite for adults, available by appointment only.
The main restaurant is open for dinner from 6 PM to 10 PM.
